Query GraphQL tooltip: Write a GraphQL query against the data space's datapoints and sources. Suggestions come from the backend's schema. Only queries are allowed: mutations and subscriptions are blocked.
GraphQL mutations not allowed: Mutations and subscriptions are not allowed here: this mode only runs queries.
GraphQL schema unavailable: Suggestions unavailable: the backend does not expose its schema (introspection is disabled or unreachable). Highlighting still works.
GraphQL no results: The query ran successfully but returned no data.
Apollo Studio link title: Opens this GraphQL endpoint in Apollo's own UI, in a new tab
Intro title: One place to query the whole Data Space
Intro text: Data Space gathers files uploaded to MinIO and data collected from external APIs. Source Connector keeps them synchronised and Query Engine indexes them, so everything can be searched from this page, whatever the original source. Pick the mode that fits your question with the tabs below:
Intro tagline: Search files uploaded to MinIO and data collected from external APIs, in four different ways.
Intro mode simple: Type a word or a value and get every file that contains it. The quickest way to find out what's there.
Intro mode advanced: Filter objects by key/value pairs, as text or as a date range, on CSV, JSON or GeoJSON files. Keys and values are suggested as you type.
Intro mode sql: Write SQL against the PostgreSQL tables of the Data Space (e.g. sources) for precise selections, joins and nested fields.
Intro mode graphql: Ask for exactly the fields you need from datapoints and sources, with suggestions from the schema. Read-only: queries only.
Intro visibility: The selector at the top decides whose data you search: private (your own), shared (shared with your pilot) or public. Results appear below the search panel.

Simple search limits title: Not searched by the Simple search
Simple search warning API_TRUNCATED: API "{{source}}": only its first pages were searched
Simple search warning ORION_TRUNCATED: Only the first Orion entities were searched
Simple search warning MAX_RESULTS: Too many results from the APIs / Orion: only the first ones are shown
Search in info: The collections searched: Sources (the API data), Datapoints (Orion) and Files (MinIO). Your choice is remembered in this browser; Find all, too, finds everything only in the chosen collections. The suggestions follow the choice.
Not searched by the Simple search reason: {{collection}}: disabled for the Simple search in the configuration (simpleSearchOptions)
Not searched by the Advanced search reas: {{collection}}: not stored in MongoDB (collections.toMongo = false), the Advanced search can't find it
Not in GraphQL: {{collections}}: not stored in MongoDB, the GraphQL queries don't find this data.
Not in SQL: {{collections}}: not copied to PostgreSQL, the SQL queries don't find this data (use Advanced search or GraphQL).
Select at least one source: Select at least one collection to search.
Values not suggested: Some values of "{{key}}" are not suggested (e.g. the datapoints' measures: too many distinct values). Type the exact value: the search finds them anyway.
Values not suggested short: Some values of this key are not suggested: type the exact value.
Status log info: The HTTP requests of the Source-Connector (to the APIs, Orion, the mapper, Keycloak), failed and successful, newest first. Click a request to see its details.
Status log masked: The credentials are hidden (the values of the request headers, and tokens, passwords and keys in query params, body and response): they are shown only to administrators.
Status log masked no auth: The credentials are hidden (the values of the request headers, and tokens, passwords and keys in query params, body and response): authentication is disabled.
Status log error: The status log could not be loaded.
Status log cut: Cut by the Source-Connector: {{length}} characters in total.
Ignore url: Ignore the requests of this url (they are listed only when you filter by url)
Ignored urls info: Their requests are not listed, unless you filter by url. A prefix covers every url that begins with it.
Status log action error: The change could not be saved.
Ignored in config info: Ignored in the configuration of the Query-Engine (statusLog.ignoredUrls / ignoredPrefixes): to list its requests again, remove it there.
Unwrap info: Every array of the results becomes one result per element (the rows of a JSON or CSV file, the features of a GeoJSON...): its fields, unWrappedFrom (the array) and the other fields of the document as ../<field>. Only the arrays at the top level, or at the level written next to the buttons; with "Only arrays of objects", the arrays of values stay as they are.
Unwrap path: Level (empty: top; e.g. data or data.items)
Unwrap path info: The level to unwrap, a dotted path of fields: an object (its arrays) or an array (only that one). The other fields come with ../ for the object holding the arrays, ../../ for the one above it, and so on. Documents without it are shown as they are.
Status log retention: Not necessarily every request: the successful ones are deleted after a retention period (statusLog.successRetentionDays of the Source-Connector), the failed ones are kept.
Status log since: Failed requests are collected since {{errors}}, successful ones since {{successes}} (except those already deleted after the retention period).
Status log successes since: Successful requests are collected since {{successes}} (except those already deleted after the retention period).
Ignore prefix label: Ignore the urls that begin with
Invalid prefix: A prefix needs at least the scheme and the host, e.g. https://dx-lab.eng.it/
Prefix info: Every url that begins with it is ignored
Ignored by prefix: Its url begins with the ignored prefix {{prefix}}
Restore prefix: List again the urls that begin with {{prefix}}
Source connector info: The management of the Source-Connector: rebuilding keys, values and entries, and the reset of the incremental APIs.
Source connector not configured: The address of the Source-Connector is not configured: set "sourceConnectorBaseUrl" in assets/config.json.
Rebuild entries info: Rebuilds the keys, values and entries (the suggestions of the searches) from the stored records. The records are not changed; it can take a while.
Incremental reset info: Deletes every record of the APIs selected (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, keys, values and entries) and polls them again from startDateValue. Not reversible: it needs the management password, and every reset stays in the log below.
Incremental reset disabled: Disabled: the management password (managementSecret) is not set in the configuration of the Source-Connector.
No incremental APIs: No incremental APIs in the configuration of the Source-Connector.
Incremental reset confirm: Every record of {{apis}} will be deleted and polled again from the start. Continue?
Cache info: The cache of the datapoints queries (GraphQL): for each query its versions, the active one is answered. Choose the active version, back up the active ones, bring a backup back.
Back up now info: The active versions (of the queries filtered) are kept until the backup is deleted
Cache backup deleted: Backup deleted ({{released}} versions released: the oldest are deleted beyond keepVersions).
Backups info: Make active: the versions of the backup answer again. Delete: its versions are no longer kept (management password needed).
Delete backup confirm: The versions kept only by the backup of {{when}} will be deleted (beyond keepVersions). Not reversible.
Cached queries info: Click a query to see its versions; "Make active" answers that version from now on.
Deactivate cache info: The active versions (of the queries filtered) become previous: the next request computes the data again
Deactivate cache confirm all: The active versions of every query become previous: the next requests compute the data again (slower) and write new versions. Nothing is deleted: they stay in the history and can be made active again. Continue?
Deactivate cache confirm filtered: The active versions of the queries containing "{{filter}}" become previous: the next requests compute the data again (slower) and write new versions. Nothing is deleted: they stay in the history and can be made active again. Continue?
Cache deactivated: {{reset}} active versions deactivated: the next requests compute the data again.
Admin token needed: Authentication is disabled in the Query-Engine: managing the cache needs its admin token (authConfig.adminToken). It is kept only while this page is open.
Notification queue info: The notifications of Orion are processed one at a time, in arrival order. The queue is kept in memory: a restart of the Source-Connector loses the waiting ones (the daily check sends again the distributions that changed).
Configuration info: What can be seen of the configuration of the Source-Connector, read only: the sources it collects and the APIs it polls. Nothing secret is shown (no headers, keys or passwords; the credentials in the urls are hidden).
API connector disabled: The API connector is disabled: these APIs are not polled.
Max window ignored info: maxWindow is configured without an end date param (endDateParam): the requests are not split.
